item.title: Schools Shut, Teachers Strike Threat, Dorian Remembered
item.ns0:title: Schools Shut, Teachers Strike Threat, Dorian Remembered
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, a massive strike by school administrators forces thousands of public school students home early just days into the new school term, sparking sharp reactions from government officials and warnings of further union action. Seven years after the devastation of Hurricane Dorian, we reflect on the painful lessons of the monster storm and examine how rebuilding efforts are transforming hard-hit northern communities. Plus, we bring you the latest on a shocking Family Island shooting captured on video, the launch of a major pet registration crackdown, and a historic multimillion-dollar tourism investment on Great Stirrup Cay. Stay tuned for all these stories, a celebration of Bahamian history in the sporting world, and your complete weather forecast.
